claim: National TV segment describing a coast-to-coast mahjong resurgence and noting the 2021 cultural-appropriation controversy.
excerpt: Search summary: players of all ages at tables coast to coast; features Lucky Danger's hidden parlor in DC Chinatown and Nicole Wong; mentions a Texas company accused of appropriation in 2021 for tiles without Chinese symbols (some sets >$400).
title: Mahjong thriving as players embrace community and connection
